extraction_notes: The shared datasheet curves identify SS215-SS220 and SS28-SS220 groups rather than an individual SS220 trace; points retain those group semantics.
The electrical table publishes CJ = 300 pF for the SS28-SS220 group at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz.
The electrical table publishes IR = 0.05 mA at rated reverse voltage for the SS28-SS220 group at TA = 25 degC and 10 mA at TA = 100 degC; the structured value preserves the 25 degC maximum.
The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time row; reverse recovery is omitted.
